title: Speculative enquiry: civil designer / graduate civil engineer
content_text: Careers page: always on the lookout for talented people (from cadets to senior level). Positions: Civil Team: Civil Designer, Civil Engineer; Structural Team: Structural Drafter, Structural Engineer. Forward Cover Letter and Resume to admin@vtce.com.au.
apply_instructions: Email cover letter and resume to admin@vtce.com.au (careers page says so).
